positions.name: KestrelwoodCalibrationVerification
positions.frame: how is the Kestrelwood spectrograph's calibration established and what verifies it holds?
positions.why: All three expressions cohere around the calibration state of the Kestrelwood spectrograph: src-1 narrates the calibration at 88.4 MHz verified against June reference plates across the full observing band, while src-2 and src-3 restate the instrument identity and calibration parameters as structured metadata of the same claim. The directional read is the verification chain — what instrument, what value, what reference — rather than any one field alone.
